title: Syphilis screening during pregnancy (asymptomatic pregnant women)

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends early, universal screening for syphilis infection during pregnancy; if an individual is not screened early in pregnancy, the USPSTF recommends screening at the first available opportunity.

action: Screen for syphilis infection during pregnancy, early in pregnancy or at the first available opportunity if not screened early

all.note: Pregnancy active during the measurement year; the engine cannot confirm the pregnancy episode overlaps the year

uncomputable.needs: absence of signs or symptoms of syphilis (clinical assessment)

numerator.quote: screening for syphilis infection during pregnancy
numerator.note: Guideline requires the test within the pregnancy episode; the measurement-year window only approximates the pregnancy period and cannot check that it was early in pregnancy
